# Biomes

<div class="rr-banner"><img src="../../assets/rogue-roller/biomes.jpg" alt="The Rogue Roller biomes"></div>

There are **6 biomes**. Their order is shuffled at the start of every run, and after the 6th biome the same order repeats. Each biome ends at a gate, see [biomes and gates](basics.md#biomes-and-gates).

## Lengths

The length depends on how many biomes into the run you are, not which biome it is.

| Biome number | Tiles long | Gate is at tile |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 60 | 60 |
| 2 | 150 | 210 |
| 3 | 320 | 530 |
| 4 | 445 | 975 |
| 5 | 570 | 1,545 |
| 6 | 695 | 2,240 |
| 7 | 820 | 3,060 |
| 8 | 945 | 4,005 |
| 9 | 1,070 | 5,075 |
| 10 | 1,195 | 6,270 |

<p class="wiki-version">Numbers on this page match Rogue Roller version 2.1.0.</p>
